top_signals.title: Activist investor urges storage firm Big Yellow to put itself up for sale
top_signals.summary: Shares in storage firm Big Yellow bounced on Wednesday after an activist investor urged the company to put itself up for sale.  The FTSE 250 self-storage provider jumped more than five per cent to 844p after Ancora Alternatives, which owns four per cent of the group, told it to consider a take-private deal.
